comparison.objective: Lower a loaded hotel pan level into a steam-table well and release it; candidate adjusts a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load balancing, close-clearance lowering, flange seating, and spill avoidance versus fine tool insertion, collar rotation, relocking, and iterative test control.
comparison.success_condition: Pan flange must rest correctly on the well, level and released, without loss/spill; candidate requires repeatable bounded axial stops.
comparison.reason: Heavy level placement into a recess tests load coordination, not tuning and locking a response element.
